company.name: SigmaOS
company.shortDescription: SigmaOS is an AI-powered browser that helps users work faster with intelligent tabs, built-in assistants, and productivity tools.
company.description: SigmaOS is a productivity-focused web browser designed for macOS that uses AI to streamline browsing and workflows. It offers features such as AI assistants, tab management, workspaces, and command-based navigation to improve efficiency. The platform helps professionals organize information, automate repetitive tasks, and browse more productively.

productsAndServices.description: A web browser designed to organize and manage internet tabs as workspaces, supporting multitasking and collaboration.
productsAndServices.name: SigmaOS Browser

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables multiple users to share and work together in shared browser workspaces in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Collaborative Workspaces (Co-browsing)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered assistant integrated into the browser that provides contextual answers, searches, and summaries based on the current webpage.
productsAndServices.name: Airis Assistant

productsAndServices.description: A search tool activated by the spacebar that allows users to quickly search through tabs, internet, commands, and bookmarks.
productsAndServices.name: Lazy Search

productsAndServices.description: A system to organize browser tabs into separate lists or rooms, allowing grouping and easy navigation between tasks and logins.
productsAndServices.name: Workspaces

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows users to view and work on two websites simultaneously within the browser.
productsAndServices.name: Split Screen
